title: `fetch` of URL with space fails during prerendering with `npm run build`

labels.name: p2-nice-to-have
labels.description: SvelteKit cannot be used by a small number of people, quality of life improvements, etc.

body:
**Describe the bug**
When fetching an URL that contains spaces e.g. `/my static file.md` (escaped `/my%20static%20file.md`), the `fetch` tries to access a double escaped url `/my%20static%20file.md` (escaped `/my%2520static%2520file.md`) and generates a 404 html page in the file system under `/build/my%20static%20file.md/index.html`. On the browser side, the fetch works.

**Logs**
The build fails with:

```
> 404 /articles/recipe/Crushing%20bird%20nests%20at%20Nardah.md (fetched from /recipe/iiGzJN9IX0ILE81ECwNuIpJ6LUOsWbigIvMuTIkOxs9ISrFZQIMBb8pJybuBzdsZQQ)
```

**To Reproduce**

Make a route with a load function that fetches an URL with spaces in it. Use adapter static. The file will be fetched correctly in the browser but will fail during generation with `npm run build`.

I can make an example repo later if needed.

**Expected behavior**
Build passing and no `/build/my%20static%20file.md/index.html` file generated.

**Severity**

This can be circumvented with only using file names that don't need to be escaped. But, considering that this error stops the build, is quite subtle and can take some time to debug. Maybe it could be considered a medium-level priority.
